'''Ruba''' was a mute [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] of unusual size for his species. He often grew uncomfortable in the heat of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and sought refuge in a bathhouse, where at times he was attended by [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] females, and on one occasion even met [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="TPM-game" />
